title: Elliott injects $1B into Pinterest to fund stock buybacks, buying convertible senior notes with an initial conversion price of $22.72 per share, a 30% premium (Nicholas G. Miller/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Nicholas G. Miller / Wall Street Journal: Elliott injects $1B into Pinterest to fund stock buybacks, buying convertible senior notes with an initial conversion price of $22.72 per share, a 30% premium — Activist investor Elliott Investment Management has injected $1 billion into Pinterest, which the company will use to repurchase shares.
